race.description: Apg Super Series 3yo Trotting C&G Fnl (G1)
race.comment: NSW Derby winner PASTOR DUNBAR (10) may have to do this the hard way given his back row draw but he came from there for a resuming win in the G3 Holmfield here two back. Since then he made it five wins on the trot and maintained a perfect record at this circuit when leading to dominate last week's heat. Just needs even luck to add to the winning streak. MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) got back on track with a strong win last week, leading to score by more than 6m. Draws wider but should be hitting his peak third up. KEAYANG BAZLENKA (9) has yet to find his brilliant juvenile form so far this season but last week's resuming fourth will have brought him on. He is too talented to dismiss. HOWDY MATE (6) draws wider than when he won last week's heat but his recent consistency is hard to knock. THE PREACHER (8) draws for a trail and is worth including in the exotics.
